The trailing lookahead (?![\d-]) allows letters and underscores after a match and lets ord_[0-9a-f]{0,13} backtrack to 12 hex characters, so invalid tokens like "ord_1a2b3c4d5e6fa1", "ord_1a2b3c4d5e6fxyz", or "SO-2019-123abc" are matched by prefix and accepted.
